thread.title: Daily Dividend Report: AAPL, SBUX, KHC, COF, EQIX

title: Daily Dividend Report: AAPL, SBUX, KHC, COF, EQIX
text:
Daily Dividend Report: AAPL, SBUX, KHC, COF, EQIX Friday, November 2, 1:34 PM ET 10 Oversold Dividend Stocks » Apple declared a cash dividend of $0.73 per share of the Company's common stock. The dividend is payable on November 15, 2018 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 12, 2018.
Starbucks declared a cash dividend of $0.36 per share, payable on November 30, 2018, to shareholders of record as of November 15, 2018.
The Kraft Heinz Company (NASDAQ: KHC ) declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.625 per share of common stock payable on Dec. 14, 2018, to stockholders of record as of Nov. 16, 2018.
Capital One Financial Corporation (NYSE: COF ) announced a quarterly dividend of $0.40 per share payable November 23, 2018, to stockholders of record as of November 12, 2018.
Equinix (NASDAQ: EQIX ) has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $2.28 per share on its common stock. The quarterly common stock dividend will be paid on December 12, 2018, to shareholders of record on November 14, 2018.
For MarketNewsVideo.com, I'm Sayoko Murase.
